name: Status 11 Code
definition: Specifies the status of an instruction.

PACK.name: Accepted
PACK.definition: Instruction has been accepted and is validated for further processing.

ATTC.name: Attendance Confirmed
ATTC.definition: Attendance is confirmed at the meeting.

CSUB.name: Cancelled By Subcustodian
CSUB.definition: Instruction has been cancelled by the agent, for example, due to an event deadline extension.

FRWD.name: Forwarded
FRWD.definition: Accepted and sent along the chain.

RCIS.name: Received By Issuer Or Registrar
RCIS.definition: Instruction has been received by Issuer, equivalent to the confirmation of receipt of votes cast electronically.

REGM.name: Registered To Participate At Meeting
REGM.definition: Rights holder has been registered to participate to the meeting.

DREG.name: Deregistration Completed
DREG.definition: Rights holder has been deregistered from the meeting participants list.
